fields.description: Gates BOTH Remedial routing AND submission point award. When 1: failed/flagged submissions route to Remedial path for the current week (T6b) AND on-time submissions earn Assignment.points_per_item only if AI verdict is valid (Failed/Flagged → 0). When 0: validation result is informational only — student stays on Core and earns full points regardless of AI verdict. Default for the current business spec (2026-05-19) is 1 for every week.
